subject: [video] n2vk_ref_me16 / n2vk_half / n2vk_fdct8_quant ready
body: The reference implementations are in kern/n2vk_ref.c and pass the host tests. n2vk_me16() routes to the reference when no backend is installed (n2vk_use(NULL) resets). Candidate rectangle, centre clamping and tie-break are exactly n2vk.h's. Note for RC: sad is u32 (<= 65280 for 16x16 8-bit), mvx/mvy int16. If you want an early speed check on 1080p, the reference is plain C (no early-out); tell me and I can add an optional exact early-exit later without changing results.
